heading: INT. TRAIN STATION LEFT-LUGGAGE OFFICE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. TRAIN STATION LEFT-LUGGAGE OFFICE - NIGHT
Rows of steel shelves.
Suitcases, cello cases, a taxidermy owl in a crate.
A clock above the counter reads 11:52.
CORDELIA MBEKI, thirties, stands at the counter with a claim ticket.
She slides it across.
Behind the counter, AUGUSTINE PELLETIER, an older clerk, takes it without looking and shuffles away into the shelves.
She waits.
Then the door behind her opens and RAFAELA DOMINGUES walks in, shaking rain off her coat.
She stops when she sees her.
She doesn't move.
Cordelia turns her head and stops as well.
The rain on the roof is the only sound.
You came.
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: I said I would.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: She steps to the counter and sets down a small leather case.
She doesn't open it.
Cordelia looks at the case, then at her.
That's the one?
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: That's the one.
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: She pushes it an inch toward her.
Cordelia puts a finger on the lid and takes it away again.
I thought you'd have thrown it into the river by now.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: I thought about it.
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: What stopped you?
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: The river was cold.
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: Augustine returns with a battered suitcase.
He sets it on the counter and looks from one to the other.
She lifts her eyes to meet his.
Ticket three-oh-seven.
units.name: AUGUSTINE

units.text: That's mine.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: She grips the handle.
Rafaela lays a hand on the other end of it.
They stand with the suitcase between them, both holding on.
Your train is at midnight.
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: It is.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Leave it.
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: I can't.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Rafaela lets go.
She picks up her leather case and holds it against her chest.
Cordelia drags the suitcase off the counter, and at the door she pauses with her back turned.
Keep the case. Please.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: She goes out into the rain.
Rafaela stays where she is until the clock reads 11:58, then lays the case on the counter in front of the clerk.
Could you hold this for me?
units.name: RAFAELA

units.text: Augustine takes it and writes out a ticket.
